# Code of Conduct

Keep project discussions technical, focused, and respectful.

## Expectations

When participating in issues, discussions, pull requests, reviews, or other project spaces:

- Discuss the work, ideas, and technical tradeoffs rather than attacking people.
- Keep criticism specific and constructive. Disagreement is welcome; hostility is not.
- Avoid harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory abuse, spam, and deliberate disruption.
- Do not publish another person's private information without permission.
- Respect requests to return an off-topic conversation to the project at hand.

These expectations guide participation; they do not define a formal dispute process.

## Moderation

Maintainers may remove content, lock conversations, or restrict participation when needed to enforce these rules.

GitHub's policies and moderation tools also apply.
